name: By a Thread
label: Revelation
lede: Vancouver hardcore kids from Strain who fell for Sunny Day Real Estate, made one small-run Revelation LP in 1999, and kept coming back to the band every decade or so.

eras.title: Strain goes soft-spoken
eras.text: Two members of the Vancouver hardcore band Strain started By a Thread in 1996 and went somewhere slower and more melodic, without dropping the message.

years.h: Ex-Strain members form By a Thread in Vancouver
years.p: John Franco (guitar and vocals) and Sean Lande (guitar), both from Strain, start By a Thread with bassist Steven Fairweather and drummer Joe Franco.

years.h: By a Thread borrow from Sunny Day Real Estate and Sparkmarker
years.p: Revelation's bio names By a Thread's touchstones as Seattle's [[Sunny Day Real Estate|86b24e8f-a4d9-4c84-83ee-fde0d14ad9fa]] and Vancouver's own [[Sparkmarker|f3f3410d-e096-438e-be37-905009125da4]], with lyrics about society, tradition and personal independence carried over from the members' hardcore bands.

q: My lyrics come from life experiences.
years.src: Revelation Records · Revelation Records pressing history
years.h: Last of the Daydreams: 226 on white vinyl · REV 82
years.p: By a Thread's only album of the era, ten songs opening with Surface. Revelation pressed a single vinyl run of 226 on white.
years.xp: Revelation's bio pitched John Franco's lyrics as personal and unfiltered, and quoted him on where they came from.

eras.title: One more record, then quiet
eras.text: More than a decade after the LP, By a Thread put out a self-titled 12" on Revelation and then went silent for years.

years.src: Revelation Records pressing history · No Echo
years.p: A second By a Thread record on Revelation, pressed 330 on gray and 219 on black. After it, the band goes quiet.

eras.title: Mirrored Life
eras.text: Sean Lande and John Franco rebuilt By a Thread with a new rhythm section, including a drummer from Gob, and spent about two years on an album shaped by grief.

years.h: Mirrored Life: By a Thread's first record since 2011 · Spartan
years.p: Made over about two years and recorded in pieces at several places, with Gabe Mantle of [[Gob|c6903a2e-063c-4f91-a284-17b8f421be7b]] on drums and Carl McBeath on bass. Sean Lande says loss and grief shaped the songs.
years.xp: Lande told No Echo that channeling whatever the band was feeling had been constant since its members were kids in hardcore bands.

years.h: By a Thread play their first show back
years.p: By a Thread return to the stage on October 10, with European dates planned.
